rationale: A view-bridge error-reporting fix. The catch around the UI framework's after-dispatch hook now reports through __pulpReportDispatchError__, like handler errors: it counts the error, keeps its message ahead of the stack, and falls back to console.error when no __dispatchError__ is installed. Dispatch order, batching and rendering are unchanged. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'WidgetBridge reports an after-dispatch hook error even without a dispatch hook'
